items.title: How we halved DNS build delay and cut memory use by 85%
items.blurb: Zone setting changes used to rebuild entire DNS zones, even ones with tens of millions of records. Here is how we built a planner that picks the smallest safe build, cutting full builds by 40%, peak memory by 85%, and halving build delay.

items.title: Google and Meta Open-source TorchTPU to Bring Native PyTorch Support to Google TPUs
items.blurb: TorchTPU is an open-source project developed by Google in collaboration with Meta that provides a native PyTorch backend for Google TPUs.

items.title: Article: Systemic Approach to Memory, Knowledge, and Context in Agentic AI Architectures
items.blurb: The article argues that reliable agentic AI architecture depends on a context engine that selects, injects, compresses, and expires information before it reaches the model.

items.title: Podcast: Educating an Architect: A Conversation with Luca Mezzalira
items.blurb: In this podcast, Michael Stiefel spoke to Luca Mezzalira about software architecture as a socio-technical discipline that balances technological design with an organization's social and managerial context.

items.title: Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT
items.blurb: GitHub’s annual month-long game jam is back for its 14th year! This November, make a game inspired by the theme SHIFT. Change gears, swap perspectives, bend reality, or just press a certain key.
